insights.headline: Rupee jumps 1% on RBI defence; gold fades below $4,200 as December Fed hike bets firm
points: Gold hit $4,206 Monday, its highest since Oct 2, on the energy-ceasefire news, then faded to ~$4,169 as December Fed hike odds reached ~87%.
The rupee jumped about 1% after the RBI's weekend package: a special dollar window for oil companies plus a 20% reserve on current-account FX hedges.
Bank of America says only a dovish Fed or renewed debasement fears can reverse gold's slide; Kazakhstan's central bank has started selling gold instead.
Silver held its $58.50-$59.69 support zone for ten days; MCX silver traded near Rs 2.25 lakh/kg, gold near Rs 1.50 lakh/10g.
Indian gold ETF inflows jumped 71% to Rs 4,451 crore in September as the price dip drew buyers ahead of Dhanteras on November 6.
insights.summary: Gold hit $4,206 Monday on a softer dollar and Trump's energy-ceasefire claim, then faded to ~$4,169 as December Fed hike odds hit ~87% ahead of US inflation data. The rupee jumped ~1% after the RBI's weekend package - a special dollar window for oil firms and tighter FX-derivative rules. Bank of America says only a dovish Fed or renewed debasement fears can reverse gold's slide; Kazakhstan's central bank started selling gold. Silver held near $60; MCX gold stayed near Rs 1.50 lakh/10g, silver around Rs 2.25 lakh/kg. Gold ETF inflows jumped 71% in September ahead of Dhanteras.

items.summary: The rupee rose about 1% on Monday in its sharpest rally in months after the RBI's weekend package to defend the currency: a special dollar window for state-run oil companies' daily needs and tighter rules on currency-derivative trades. The currency had slid more than 7% this year to a record low near 96.96, and the rebound eases landed costs for bullion importers ahead of the festive season.
items.title: Rupee jumps 1% as RBI curbs dollar demand

items.summary: The RBI ordered forex dealers to hold a 20% 'foreign exchange risk reserve' on derivatives hedging current-account FX needs, and cut the threshold for derivative trades without proof of underlying exposure to $5 million from $100 million. Rebooking cancelled contracts is now barred - part of the October 10 package to curb rupee speculation.
items.title: RBI tightens rules on rupee non-deliverable contracts, widens 20% cash reserve requirement

items.summary: Bank of America says gold will likely only bottom once inflation and Iran-war fears ease, the dollar stops rising and the Fed exits its hiking cycle - or if renewed US fiscal-repression fears revive the debasement trade. It also warns central-bank demand could turn into a year-end source of weakness: about 90% of the rise in central-bank gold holdings' value came from valuation, not buying.
items.title: Gold price needs a dovish Fed or renewed debasement fears to reverse its downtrend - Bank of America

items.summary: Gold rose Monday on a softer dollar and lower oil after Trump's surprise 'effective immediately' Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire - though Zelenskyy awaited details. Spot gold gained 0.3% to $4,206.01, its highest since October 2; December futures added 0.3% to $4,230.40. Focus now shifts to Wednesday's US CPI, with traders seeing an 86% chance of a December Fed hike.
items.title: Gold gains on weaker oil, dollar; US inflation data in focus

items.summary: Gold and silver gave back early gains Monday as December Fed hike bets firmed. Spot gold fell 0.59% to ~$4,168.90 and silver slid 0.96% to $60.12, with markets pricing ~17% odds of an October hike and ~88% by December. Brent settled 1.8% higher at $106.65 on Middle East supply risk around Hormuz, keeping inflation fears alive ahead of Wednesday's US CPI and Thursday's PPI and retail sales.
items.title: Gold, silver soften as markets price in December Fed hike risk - Kitco PM Report

items.summary: Silver held a key support zone around $58.50-$59.69 - the 78.6% Fibonacci retracement of its prior advance - for about ten days despite a bearish trend, FXEmpire's technical analysis notes. A weekly breakout above $62.04 could signal a reversal toward $64.11, though the analysis cautions that rallies are likely to face selling pressure while the dominant trend remains down.
items.title: Silver (XAG/USD) Price Forecast: Key Support Holds as Reversal Signal Nears

items.summary: Kazakhstan's central bank is switching from top gold buyer to seller, planning to cut gold's share of reserves by about 3 points to ~75% by year-end as 24-year-high Treasury yields make dollars more attractive. Deputy governor Aliya Moldabekova called the 386-tonne hoard, ~78% of reserves, 'uncomfortably high'. Turkey and Russia had already sold some gold earlier this year.
items.title: Kazakhstan starts gold sales as treasuries burnish dollar appeal

items.summary: Gold and silver are likely to trade in a range with a slightly positive bias next week, analysts told PTI, as rupee weakness cushions domestic bullion. On MCX, December gold gained Rs 1,109 last week to Rs 1.51 lakh/10g; silver eased Rs 122 to Rs 2.25 lakh/kg. LKP's Jateen Trivedi said a weaker rupee raises landed import costs, supporting MCX gold even when overseas prices face pressure.
items.title: Gold and Silver Prices to Trade in Range with Positive Bias as Rupee Weakness Cushions Domestic Bullion

items.summary: Indian gold ETFs drew Rs 4,450.61 crore in September, a seven-month high, even as domestic gold fell nearly 5%, AMFI data shows. Inflows jumped from Rs 2,596.7 crore in August; January-September inflows of ~Rs 45,925 crore already top all of 2025's Rs 42,961 crore. Mirae Asset's Suranjana Borthakur called it a strategic, allocation-led shift toward gold as a haven amid uncertainty.
items.title: Gold ETF inflows hit 7-month high in September despite 5% fall in bullion

items.summary: With Dhanteras on November 6, Outlook Money breaks down gold's ~23% slide from its $5,417 record to ~$4,185 on October 12. MCX December-4 futures traded at Rs 1,50,001/10g, 16% below their Rs 1,77,590 peak. Surging US Treasury yields drove the correction, the piece notes, citing Mirae Asset's 'Why Gold ETF Now?' thesis - leaving festive buyers weighing whether the pullback is a buying window.
items.title: Festive Buying Meets Global Pullback: How To Read Gold's 23% Correction From Record Highs Ahead Of Dhanteras

trending.summary: A 1% rupee rebound after the RBI's weekend package - special dollar window for oil firms, 20% reserve on FX hedges - is softening the blow of global weakness for domestic gold and silver prices.
trending.title: RBI's rupee defence is cushioning MCX

trending.summary: Gold popped to $4,206 on the energy-ceasefire news then faded as December Fed hike odds hit ~87%; BofA says only a dovish Fed or renewed debasement fears reverse the slide.
trending.title: December Fed hike bets cap gold's rebound

trending.summary: Silver held its $58.50-$59.69 Fibonacci support zone for ten days; MCX futures sit around Rs 2.25 lakh/kg as analysts see a range-bound week with a mildly positive bias.
trending.title: Silver holds key supports as MCX stays range-bound

trending.summary: Gold ETF inflows jumped 71% to Rs 4,451 crore in September as investors bought the pullback; with Dhanteras near, a 23% correction has festive shoppers weighing timing.
trending.title: India buys the dip ahead of Dhanteras
